workstream.title: YouTube creator runtime / adaptive content factory

human_intent: Build the real provider-agnostic engine behind the Channels UI so every worker-soluble piece is implemented, persisted and testable before asking the human for API keys, OAuth consent, channel creation or billing actions that cannot be simulated legitimately.
already_decided: Keep the current Channels UI visual skeleton; infrastructure stays behind a small provider-agnostic frontend contract.
Missing credentials are branch-local gates, not stop conditions for architecture, database, jobs, fixtures, mocks, storage, tests or deployment.
Never store API keys, OAuth refresh tokens or private payloads in GitHub or browser localStorage.
Capabilities must distinguish MOCK, CONFIGURED, VERIFIED_REAL and BLOCKED; no green state from configuration alone.
The published-channel timeline is modeled around publication N and the interval until publication N+1, with metrics switchable on the same X axis.
Ideas/stories, production, publication and analytics are separate durable domains even if the UI hides that complexity.
high_value_targets: Deploy durable creator schema and object-storage ownership without disturbing existing Prometeo domains.
Expose a stable frontend contract for channels, stories, ready/published videos, jobs, timeline and work requests.
Make async jobs restart-safe, idempotent and cost-bounded with fixture-based end-to-end proofs before credentials exist.
Leave Google/YouTube/Gemini/video/TTS adapters in a state where credentials activate probes rather than trigger new architecture work.
Persist a precise LAST_RETURN and capability matrix so another chat can continue without reconstructing this conversation.
known_failures: Do not treat IndexedDB as backend durability for server-side publication.
Do not infer storage readiness when health evidence is absent.
Do not mark Gemini text/video/voice as one verified capability from one key save operation.
Do not call a syntax check an end-to-end integration test.
Do not expose a service-role key or provider secret in the published HTML.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen
